title: Ask HN: Are open-weight models like Qwen used in production?
excerpt: I've seen some mentions of open weight models api usage going up on Vercel and governments pushing for sovereign AI and also Shopify using open weight and frontier models.
content_html:
I've seen some mentions of open weight models api usage going up on Vercel and governments pushing for sovereign AI and also Shopify using open weight and frontier models.

But what's still not clear to me are the use cases for such models and whether they're really deployed in production.
